S1 — The required activation census cites unrelated operations as governing cost authority.
Invariant/authority: USER decision magic-item-kept-activation-census (2026-10-13) and repair 19.4.6.10 explicitly require every retained cost row to quote ITS GOVERNING PRINTED SENTENCE, with reviewers checking those bindings against print. design-and-pr-review-policy.md requires reviewing proof mechanisms against their actual claims. A verbatim sentence elsewhere in the same item does not authorize this operation's cost. This is a defect in the expressly required reviewed evidence artifact, not a demand for a lexical omission screen or new product semantics.

The governing Wish sentence is 'While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge and cast the wish spell from it' (records.json:110618), already correctly present in this row's equipmentSentences. Terrify's actual governing action sentence is in records.json:128964 and already in that row's equipmentSentences. These are two different action-type counterexamples, not mere wording choices.
